docs.summary: Binds a skinned [`Mesh`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Mesh) to a set of bones (which are [`ModelNode`](#api~Prowl.Clay.ModelNode)s).
docs.remarks: A [`ModelNode`](#api~Prowl.Clay.ModelNode) with `SkinIndex >= 0` is the host of a `SkinnedMeshRenderer`; the mesh's [`BoneWeights`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Mesh~BoneWeights) reference bone indices within this [`BoneNodeIndices`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Skin~BoneNodeIndices) array, not absolute node indices.

docs.summary: Node index of the skeleton root, the closest common ancestor of all joint nodes. When the source declared an explicit skeleton root (glTF `skin.skeleton`), that index is used directly.

members.name: BoneNodeIndices
members.signature: public required int[] BoneNodeIndices { get; init; }

docs.summary: Indices into [`Nodes`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Model~Nodes) of the joint nodes, in the order referenced by vertex [`BoneWeight`](#api~Prowl.Clay.BoneWeight)s and [`BindPoses`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Mesh~BindPoses).

members.name: InverseBindPoses
members.signature: public required Float4x4[] InverseBindPoses { get; init; }

docs.summary: Inverse bind-pose matrices, parallel to [`BoneNodeIndices`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Skin~BoneNodeIndices). Transforms a vertex from mesh-local space into the joint's local space at bind time.
